headers.//: frame-ancestors replaces X-Frame-Options; script-src allows inline because the theme script must run before first paint to prevent a white flash, and the JSON-LD block is inline by definition. There is no user input, no query-param rendering and no third-party script on this site, so the inline allowance costs nothing real.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests

headers.//: Next emits the share card as an extensionless file named `opengraph-image`. Static hosting types files by extension, so without this it goes out as application/octet-stream and social scrapers drop the card — og:image:type in the HTML does not override the real header.
Content-hashed filenames — safe to cache forever. Fonts are hashed by next/font, so they fall under this too.
